plugins.name: webular
plugins.description: Web research CLI that sends its judgment calls to Jev, TypeSafe's System One decision model, and does the rest with free and open-source parts: scrape, crawl, map, extract, search, summarize, and gather context as Mastra workflows on Bun, run with Effect and XState from a fixed mise task graph. It runs on your machine, is open source, respects robots.txt by default, and can replay a run with the same result. Jev's key is the only API key, and it works without one.
